meaning.zh:
“动脑筋” 或 “用心想想”。

这个短语起源于英国俚语，把头部比作一条面包。在伦敦的Cockney俚语中，“loaf of bread” 通过押韵，本义转化为代表 “head”（头）的意思。因此，“use your loaf” 就代表着使用你的头脑，即动脑筋的意思。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from British slang, comparing the head to a loaf of bread. In London Cockney rhyming slang, "loaf of bread" rhymes with "head". Therefore, "use your loaf" means using your head or thinking carefully.

lines.en: Come on, *use your loaf*! It's not that complicated.
lines.zh: 拜托，动动脑筋！这没有那么复杂。

lines.en: If you *use your loaf*, you'll figure out the solution soon.
lines.zh: 如果你动动脑筋，很快就能找到解决方法。

lines.en: She didn't need my help; she just needed to *use her loaf*.
lines.zh: 她不需要我的帮助，她只需要动脑筋。
